Committee: Judiciary
Sponsor: Barfoot
Analyst: Pete Grogan
Date: 02/01/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 68 as introduced proposes a Constitutional Amendment, which if ratified, would remove probate court jurisdiction over orphans business in each county.
In addition, this bill will increase the proclamation expenses of the Governor, paid from the State General Fund, by an estimated $100,000 for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2023.
Tom Whatley, Chairperson
Judiciary
